verdict.rationale: Reducto's docs show confidence scores on Parse elements and per-criterion confidence on Classify. Extract fields can carry bounding-box citations, and Studio has a citation viewer, which supports manual verification. Nothing shows confidence scores on Extract output fields, any calibration, or a review path that routes low-confidence fields to humans. missing for 10: per-field confidence scores on Extract output, evidence that scores are calibrated, a human-in-the-loop review queue or low-confidence routing, independent corroboration.
